source.title: NSW Spectacles Program — List of Providers
source.date_limitation: PDF metadata creation/modification is retained, not treated as each provider verification date or an explicit publication date.
source.capture_method: Extract every gridded table page; validate the seven column headers and each provider row; preserve original cell text, page/row positions and content hashes.
source.source_identifier_basis: No provider IDs published. Content-derived IDs preserve each captured row; repeated identical rows have occurrence suffixes and are not silently deduplicated.
source.coverage_limitation: Participating optometrists/dispensers only; includes cross-border and potentially visiting/clinical services. No automatic store admission or current-status inference.
